title: Verdict
description: One agent's adjudication of one claim. `cited_file` is the anti-hallucination and anti-forgery control: a verdict is only accepted if that file exists inside the clone root and was actually read by this agent during this run.

tier.description: Only these four. 'partial' is a modifier on the summary, never a fifth tier.

downgrade.description: GRADE-style downgrade domains. Records why evidence is weak, not just that it is.

partial.description: Evidence is real but incomplete (e.g. config present, hook missing). A modifier, not a tier.

cited_files.description: Clone-relative paths this agent actually read to reach the verdict.
